decisions.statement: A name here is chosen outside akasha.
The page states the name its folder is under.
The folder is found under the folder the page sits in.
A page claims a folder by stating the property with that folder.
A page claiming a folder claims every file that folder has.
A page states whether it has the folder rather than what the folder holds.
The property speaks for every file the folder holds rather than for one of them.
A property saying its folder holds bytes says so of every file beneath it.
A property saying its folder is judged for no length says so of each of them too.

definition: a page property held in a folder whose name is stated
